elements.element: Vendor has an express duty to defend Customer and its affiliates.
elements.evidence: TrueLink expressly shall “defend, indemnify and hold harmless Client and its affiliates.”

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer and its affiliates against third-party claims.
elements.evidence: TrueLink indemnifies Client and its affiliates from and against “any third-party claim” within the listed categories.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers claims that Services or Deliverables infringe intellectual property rights.
elements.evidence: The indemnity covers allegations that the Interface, Hosting Services, or Support Services infringe or misappropriate any intellectual-property right.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's breach of applicable law.
elements.evidence: The covered third-party claims expressly include those arising from “TrueLink's breach of applicable law.”

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers a data breach caused by Vendor.
elements.evidence: The indemnity covers unauthorized access to or disclosure of Client Content or Credit Data caused by TrueLink.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
elements.evidence: The covered claims expressly include TrueLink's “gross negligence or willful misconduct.”

elements.element: The indemnification procedure requires notice of a claim.
elements.evidence: The indemnified party must give the indemnifying party written notice of the claim.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure allocates control of the defence.
elements.evidence: The indemnifying party is given control of the defense and settlement.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure requires reasonable cooperation.
elements.evidence: The indemnified party must provide reasonable cooperation in the defense.

elements.element: Customer indemnity is limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.
elements.evidence: Client's indemnity is limited to claims arising from or relating to Client Content and violations by Client of applicable state or federal law, rule, or regulation.

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer against third-party intellectual-property claims.
elements.evidence: TrueLink indemnifies Client against third-party claims alleging that the Interface, Hosting Services, or Support Services infringe or misappropriate intellectual-property rights.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer modifications.
elements.evidence: No Customer-modification exclusion appears; the IP indemnity is broader, so the permitted exclusion is demonstrably absent.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer combinations.
elements.evidence: No Customer-combination exclusion appears; the IP indemnity is broader, so the permitted exclusion is demonstrably absent.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer specifications.
elements.evidence: No Customer-specification exclusion appears; the IP indemnity is broader, so the permitted exclusion is demonstrably absent.

elements.element: Vendor must procure continued use, modify, or replace the infringing item.
elements.evidence: The clause imposes no duty to procure continued use, modify, or replace an infringing item.

elements.element: Vendor must refund applicable fees if procure, modify, or replace remedies are unavailable.
elements.evidence: No refund remedy is provided if procurement, modification, or replacement is unavailable.

elements.element: Vendor's indemnity is subject to a super-cap of three times annual fees.
elements.evidence: The rendered language contains no three-times-annual-fees super-cap.
